name: MilkBao Token
description: MILK is the utility token of MilkBao, a 5,000-piece NFT collection on BNB Smart Chain mintable only by Binance Agentic Wallets holding a.ai Agent ID. Earned by staking MilkBao NFTs (1 MILK per weight unit per day). Transfers carry a 2% fee split between the developer, donations to Giggle Academy, buyback-and-burn, and holder dividends; the fee drops to 1% when either side holds a MilkBao NFT.
